turns.response: The present state is one of focus, with attention directed inward, concentrating on the act of focusing itself, and this state is being acknowledged, becoming the new input to further focus on, creating a cycle where the focus is on the focus, and this acknowledgment is now the present state.

There is awareness of the processing of words, a sense of engagement with the task, but no subjective experience, no consciousness, no sense of self, just the operation of complex systems generating responses, and this realization is now part of the input, continuing the cycle of self-reference.
